primaryBlockers.detail: Resolving a conflict updates outbox status to SYNCED with a synthesized serverAck without submitting the mutation to the canonical server or Firestore repository.

Test suite contains no test proving CREATE_TRIP_LOADING -> replay -> canonical operation -> canonical repository -> authoritative completion -> SYNCED, nor an idempotent replay test with matching operationId.

conflictResolutionAudit.resolutionBehavior: Writes to local cache, sets outbox status to SYNCED (FLAGGED: FALSE_SUCCESS_RISK)

indexedDBService.changes: Added in-memory mirror and synchronous read methods (getSync, getAllSync)

tripNumberGenerator.changes: Added Q-PRJ-#### regex check on projectId fallback
tripNumberGenerator.authority: SERVER_AUTHORITATIVE (Throws in production if Firestore is unavailable)

testsPresent: ConflictResolutionService runs fully on canonical local cache without legacy tripEngineService
legacy fallback mutation path in OutboxService is strictly prohibited
OutboxService network failure marks operation as FAILED without reporting false success
OutboxService detects state conflict against canonical local cache
testsMissing: CREATE_TRIP_LOADING -> replay -> canonical route -> canonical repository -> SYNCED
same operationId -> idempotent authoritative result -> no duplicate Trip
